Higher Education Committee
Thursday, February 29, 2024
3:00 PM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:00pm

S.F. 1045: Senator Port: Postsecondary institution\'s mandated sexual harassment and sexual assault
policy amendment.

The following individuals testified on S.F.1045:
-Melissa Watschke, Title IX Administrator, Office of
Higher Education

-Sierra Roiger, student, Minnesota State - Mankato
-Nora Simondet, student, Minnesota State - Moorhead

Senator Fateh moved the A-4 amendment, MOTION ADOPTED
Senator Fateh moved the A-5 amendment, MOTION ADOPTED
Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 1045, be laid over.

S.F. 3945: Senator Putnam: Higher education previous appropriations modifications.

Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 3945, be laid over.

S.F. 4269: Senator Oumou Verbeten: Postsecondary education institutions incarcerated and postprision persons
provisions modifications.

The following individuals testified on S.F.4269:
-Commissioner Paul Schnell, Department of
Corrections

-Crystal Brakke, Deputy Assistant Commissioner for
Teaching and Learning, Department of Corrections
-Jesse Mason, Associate Vice-Chancellor for Academic
Affairs, Minnesota State Colleges and Universities
-Krystle Igbo-Ogbonna, Director of Student Access

and Academic Partnerships, Minnesota State Colleges
and Universities

-Will Cooley, Minnesota Justice Research Center

Senator Oumou Verbeten moved the A-2 amendment, MOTION ADOPTED

Senator Oumou Verbeten moved that S.F. 4269, be recommended to pass and re-referred to the Judiciary and Public Safety
Committee. - MOTION ADOPTED.

Call to order

The meeting was adjourned at 3:59pm

Uleger

Senator Omar Fateh, Chair Chris Meyer, Legis!
